help.stdout:
RADIOSS Starter version OpenRadioss
 
Command line arguments help: 
  -help           / -h                 : Print this message
  -version        / -v                 : Print RADIOSS release information
  -input [FILE]   / -i [FILE]          : Set RADIOSS Starter input file
  -nspmd [INTEGER] / -np [INTEGER]     : Set Number of RADIOSS SPMD domains 
  -nthread [INTEGER] / -nt [INTEGER]   : Set Number of SMP threads per SPMD domain
  -check                               : Check run - no restart file written
  -notrap                              : Disable error trapping
  -dynamic_lib [FILE] / -dylib [FILE]  : Set name to the dynamic library for Radioss User Interface
  -mdsdir [PATH] / -mds_libpath [PATH] : Set directory to MDS Library (default is %ALTAIR_HOME%/hwsolver/MultiscaleDesigner/%arch%)
  -outfile=[PATH]                      : Set output file directory for all output and created files
  -hstp_write                          : Write the xml file hst_input.hstp with the parameters for HyperStudy
  -hstp_read                           : Read the xml file hst_input.hstp with the parameters from HyperStudy
  -rxalea [real value]                 : Activation of nodal random noise with a [value] alea
  -rseed [real value]                  : Optional value, set the seed value for nodal random noise
  -python                              : Python function in model is safe and can be used
  -checksum_report [rootname]            : Parse output files for /CHECKSUM fingerprints and [rootname].report file
